svg.title: EcoSphere — architecture
svg.desc: EcoSphere: Enterprise ESG management platform · NestJS · Prisma · PostgreSQL · React. Sustainability data usually lives in scattered spreadsheets. EcoSphere collects environmental, social and governance records in one system, turns them into department and company ESG scores, and produces reports people review.

Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Built for the Odoo Hackathon brief but implemented on NestJS + React; there are no Odoo modules in the code.

svg.text: Behaviour lives in database configuration rather than code:

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: permissions, ESG weights, approval rules and state transitions.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each calculation also stores the factor or weights it used, so past

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: results don't shift when settings change.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Configurable workflows let each organisation adapt the

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: platform without code changes, but every rule becomes data

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that must be kept accurate: a wrong weight or factor quietly

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: skews scores until someone reviews it.
